scope: Only this JSON written; no builds/device/model/network calls, no mount or intrusion probes.
latest_route: Original Mac TAH remains trusted workflow/controller. Exactly ONE real attempt per phone App process. Import its frozen manifest and bytes, run the existing local Codex stack, observe process exit, then collect/validate sealed output and start a new process for the next attempt. This is qualification transport, not a shipping scheduler.

decision.restart_route: Recommended for the first fixture. Process restart removes the immediate need for per-role mutable registry replacement, named-environment registration, or multiple simultaneous AppServer instances. One process registers one immutable role execution environment before connect_local.
decision.instance_lifetime: An IshInstance cannot survive its owning App process. Reuse the fixed rootfs/native backing directories and mount configuration, then boot a NEW sealed instance each process. Within a future multi-role process, one sealed instance could supply independent grants, but current singleton wiring and cleanup gaps make that a separate task.
decision.layout: Use /workspace/attempts/<attemptID>/view as guest cwd and /workspace/attempts/<attemptID>/scratch as a sibling. Native /workspace is the one host-selected fixed mount; all model access comes from this attempt grants. Keep trusted imported manifest, controller state, codex_home and auth outside /workspace/model view.
decision.root_paths: Mac native-profile accepts guestWorkspaceRoot as a parameter. Its canonical file contract is relative: raw-transcript.md for Raw Guardian; inbox/*.md and outbox/revision_vN/... for Actor/Extra Guardian. A per-attempt cwd preserves these without rewriting their contents or flattening revisions. Any separate supplied prompt with literal absolute /workspace paths must be checked by the original controller; do not silently rewrite it.
decision.smallest_guest_grants: Guardian: whole view RO + sibling scratch RW. Actor: disjoint RO inbox + each previous accepted outbox/revision_vK directory, RW current outbox/revision_vN + sibling scratch. Add fixed readonly runtime directories. This uses current iSH enforcement without a kernel overlap change.
decision.not_full_parent_read_equivalence: Disjoint Actor roots preserve canonical material-file access, but parent view/outbox directory listing is not generally permitted by current guest code; it grants traversal to ancestors, not READ for directory open. Native cwd metadata also lacks a mapping when using only disjoint mounts. Thus do not claim full Mac parent-read semantics or unchanged ls/find-at-root behavior until explicitly resolved/qualified.

role_layout.result: strict JSON safety_guardian/raw-v2, maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes; original controller interprets it
strict JSON safety_guardian/extra-v2; original controller retains decision authority

role_layout.native_disjoint_option: Same material directory roots and scratch; does not presently map cwd metadata.
role_layout.provider_web: Only the original frozen attempt webEnabled grant; guest network remains DenyDirect.

layout_rules: A means /workspace/attempts/<unique trusted attemptID>; precreate all roots before preparing grants and before starting model execution.

Accepted outputs must be independent ordinary-file copies, never symlinks/hardlinks or writable aliases. Seed the current candidate with the exact prior accepted bytes/digest according to the original Mac builder; do not grant write access to the accepted tree.
Guardian scratch is outside view. This avoids a RO-parent/RW-child overlap for Guardian and does not become a declared TAH writable outcome root.

Actor disjoint directory grants fit the existing 16-root limit for V0/V1/V2 plus the five current runtime roots and scratch. Reject future manifests that cannot be represented exactly; never coalesce to a broader writable root.
Host/native owner must freeze root topology and descriptor identities while an attempt runs. Sealed mount topology does not make arbitrary host-side rename/replacement safe.
Do not use links or remount tricks to repair canonical paths. Native and guest roots must refer to the same actual directory/file identities.

native_nested_constructor_assessment.current: ScopedExecutorFileSystem::new rejects every ancestor/descendant pair and resolve uses first matching root. Merely deleting the overlap check is incorrect.
native_nested_constructor_assessment.narrow_supported_proposal: A separate explicit constructor limited to one RO attempt-view ancestor and RW candidate child (scratch disjoint). Reject duplicate normalized roots, RW ancestors, RO-under-RW exceptions, ambiguous aliases, and unknown topology. Resolve the deepest component-prefix match for every operation; authorize supplied Core policy before I/O as today.
native_nested_constructor_assessment.physical_identity_requirement: Prove the candidate descriptor root is the same directory as the no-follow relative path opened beneath the RO parent descriptor, using dev/inode metadata and the existing no-link traversal. Path prefixes alone do not prove this. No ability to replace roots or alter ACLs after construction.
native_nested_constructor_assessment.mutations: Preserve mutation_preflight, regular-file restrictions, mount-root immutability, no link traversal and authorization of all actually created parents. Ensure write/stream/create/remove and any future rename route through the selected child capability; no parent descriptor write fallback. The currently unsupported native directory listing/walk/copy need not be broadened for this constructor.
native_nested_constructor_assessment.guest_caveat: This constructor ONLY repairs native FS layout. iSH still rejects overlapping roots in ish_workspace_register; it ORs rights and does not implement nested overrides. Use disjoint guest material roots for the minimal file-level fixture. If exact whole-parent READ including ls/find is a requirement, a separate narrow guest RO-ancestor/RW-child extension is necessary and is not present.
native_nested_constructor_assessment.alternative: Keep the existing disjoint native constructor too, adding only a read-only metadata/canonicalize capability for known view/outbox ancestors if Core needs them. Do not implement this as a general readable/writable ancestor fallback. Whether current Core startup/tools need that support is unverified in this read-only review.
native_nested_constructor_assessment.recommendation: For main layout decision: preserve A/view canonical hierarchy and scratch sibling now. Choose disjoint grants for current guest kernel. Use explicit native RO-parent/RW-child only if whole-view native reads/cwd metadata are needed; otherwise retain disjoint native roots. Label root-directory enumeration as a known gap rather than calling disjoint grants completely equivalent to Mac.

actual_api_path.host_prepare: Current alma_workspace::bootstrap creates the fixed input/output/tmp fixture, boots IshInstance::boot_workspace_policy_with_workspace, constructs WorkspacePolicy/IshExecBackend/ScopedExecutorFileSystem, then embedded_runtime::register. Main needs an attempt-manifest variant here; it can register ONCE per restarted process with existing registry API.
actual_api_path.backend: IshExecBackend::new(Arc<IshInstance>, Arc<dyn ExecutionPolicy>, cleanup_timeout). Policy.prepare must validate this role exact Core filesystem/network/env intent, then create a fresh immutable single-use WorkspaceGrant and return PreparedExecution { options, grant, lease }. Reuse the sealed instance within the one attempt; do not reuse a consumed grant between commands.
actual_api_path.native: ScopedFiles::open(native_directory, Access::{ReadOnly,ReadWrite}) provides retained no-follow capabilities. ScopedExecutorFileSystem::new currently supports disjoint PathUri roots only and exposes mutation_preflight.
actual_api_path.environment: EnvironmentManager::from_embedded(backend, filesystem, EnvironmentInfo, config.http_client_factory()) is supported and registers only embedded, with no local-host fallback. Existing EmbeddedRuntime::manager calls it after config validation.
actual_api_path.server: ServerSession::connect_local(ServerConfig, InProcessConfig {codex_home, working_directory, channel_capacity}) loads strict role config, activates one EmbeddedNetworkPolicy, constructs the manager, and supplies it to InProcessStartArgs. Native Code Mode provider is injected through start_with_code_mode_provider behind the current iOS feature.
actual_api_path.AppClient: AppClient::new uses shared_mobile_client/shared_runtime. AppClient::connect_local_server forwards DEFAULT InProcessConfig; MobileClient::connect_local reuses same-id active sessions. There is no per-call role environment factory argument on these inspected methods. In the restart route, import/register the immutable role before this existing connect path; main need not introduce a general dynamic factory.
actual_api_path.wrong_factory: AppClient::attach_or_spawn_local_server is the native CLI/WebSocket attachment path, not this in-process iOS route.
actual_api_path.direct_fixture_alternative: A Rust qualification runner can call ServerSession::connect_local directly after one manifest-scoped registration to supply explicit home/host cwd. The existing registration structs/functions are crate-local, so an external crate cannot independently construct them without a narrow main-owned bridge entrypoint.

config_and_identity: Replace hardcoded alma_workspace CWD/INPUT/SCRATCH, READ_ROOTS/WRITE_ROOTS, access_map, guest_env and validate_config with an immutable manifest-derived profile for the single attempt; current validate_config is a fn pointer, so capturing arbitrary manifest state may require a small main-owned representation change or validation through the immutable runtime object.

Guardian provider_web must be false, Actor only if frozen manifest permits. Current fixed bootstrap registers provider_web=true. Guest direct sockets remain denied independently; native official Web must continue through its existing trusted network policy, not guest network grants.

Use a stable trusted codex_home outside the model view and keep existing Keychain/auth refresh callbacks. Do not copy auth into the imported workspace. Role/attempt boundaries are new processes/threads and immutable grants, not switching originator or clearing subscription data.

Keep process-wide originator @alma/tah-codex-guest unchanged. prepare_alma_client_identity rejects a previously initialized different originator and owns catalog identity stamping; role names are not client identities.

connect_local mutates process CODEX_HOME and std::env::set_current_dir. Its working_directory is a NATIVE path, not /workspace guest cwd. Use a trusted native directory or current default; put guest cwd in EnvironmentInfo and the role overrides. Current iOS path later overrides ConfigBuilder fallback_cwd with execution.guest_cwd.

Do not use AppClient::new as a freshness boundary within one process. For this qualification, start a new App process, new role session/thread, and never resume another role thread. Preserve original Mac prompts, model metadata and workflow decisions.

completion_and_collection.existing_shutdown_limit: ServerSession.disconnect is not cleanup confirmation: try_send Shutdown, 100ms sleep, abort; worker ignores upstream shutdown error. Upstream AppServerClient.shutdown itself has bounded abort fallback. Neither proves all iSH leases were released.
completion_and_collection.owned_signal: IshSession.terminate_owned(timeout) and acknowledged Closed are actual owned-process completion mechanisms; backend complete/quarantine tracks them. Active process IDs are private and no aggregate attempt-drain API was found in this bounded review.
completion_and_collection.restart_qualification: Do not inspect/publish files while the phone process remains live. Original controller must observe that exact App process exit, then collect a trusted result envelope and candidate files from that attempt. Process death ends this in-process iSH/native runtime; it is not proof the task succeeded.
completion_and_collection.success_gate: Require normal completed model/tool result, role/attempt identity match, no cleanup failure/quarantine, and independently validate canonical output bytes/schema/digests with the original Mac workflow. A crash/timeout/forced exit is a failed or indeterminate attempt even if files exist. Never accept a model-authored success marker as the trusted result envelope.
completion_and_collection.publication: Only the original Mac controller validates/publishes accepted V0/V1/V2, makes independent RO copies and prepares the next frozen manifest. Phone performs one attempt. No new phone scheduler or replacement TAH semantics is proposed.

remaining_blockers: Main must provide manifest-scoped bootstrap/role validation using the existing one-shot registration; current fixed input/output/tmp policy cannot enforce canonical TAH roles as-is.

Exact whole-parent Actor RO plus nested candidate RW is unsupported by both current native constructor and guest grant registration. Native-only constructor does not resolve guest root listing. File-level disjoint alternative preserves canonical paths but needs qualification of Core cwd/parent metadata and prompt/tool behavior.
Strict trusted import and result-envelope/observed-exit collection are not implemented by this review; retain original controller authority and artifact validation.

No aggregate asynchronous lease drain confirmation is available through the inspected bridge session disconnect. Per-process test transport avoids in-process reuse; a future production scheduler still needs explicit drain/quarantine handling.
Physical inode consistency and freeze of native topology must be maintained across both native and guest access. No enforcement or security parity is inferred merely from config text.
Source may be changing in parallel; anchors include hashes for this bounded snapshot. No fixture/build/device/model tests were performed.

source_anchors.supports: Process-wide OnceLock registration; manager creates fresh EnvironmentManager over the registered immutable backend/FS.
connect_local config preparation and global registered execution selection.
CODEX_HOME and host cwd mutation; ConfigBuilder receives explicit home and later guest cwd override.
Activated embedded network controller, execution.manager, InProcessStartArgs and native Code Mode provider start.
One shared ALMA originator; reject different initialized identity; per-home catalog identity stamp.
Disconnect is best effort try_send, 100ms delay, worker abort, no cleanup acknowledgment.
Worker discards client.shutdown result.
AppClient::new shares MobileClient and runtime; constructing another wrapper is not isolation.
AppClient::connect_local_server constructs ServerConfig and uses default InProcessConfig.
connect_local reuses an active session with same server_id.
attach_or_spawn_local_server is native CLI/WebSocket path, not the iOS embedded factory.
Current bootstrap/policy hardcodes input/output/tmp and registers once; must derive role-specific immutable profile.
Per-exec gate, immutable granted options, lease quarantine; no public aggregate role-drain API.
Constructor rejects nested roots; resolver currently selects first matching mount, not deepest.
Mutation preflight and parent checks must retain authority before I/O.
Root/leaf protection, no recursive deletion, no directory listing/walk/copy support.
Immutable Access, retained descriptor, no-follow relative operations, root_metadata available.
Lease completion/quarantine contract and private active-ID set.
Actual terminate_owned/status.closed acknowledgment gates cleanup; process drop alone insufficient.
Guest rejects overlapping logical and physical roots within a grant; conflicting live grants rejected.
Guest rights use OR plus ancestor traversal, not longest-prefix overrides; ancestor directory open requires READ.
terminate_owned waits for owned cleanup acknowledgment.
EnvironmentManager::from_embedded public API; no native-local fallback.
Upstream shutdown waits with timeout/abort fallback; Ok is not an owned-filesystem lease proof.
Raw Guardian reads raw-transcript.md at attempt root; no writableRoots; Web disabled.
Extra Guardian has inbox materials and accepted history; no writableRoots; Web disabled.
Actor currentRoot=outbox/revision_vN, seed provenance checked, only currentRoot writable.
Accepted history materialized from independent file bytes into outbox/revision_vN.
guestWorkspaceRoot is a parameter; canonical relative paths remain unchanged under a per-attempt cwd; parent read/current root write policy.
Guardian cannot enable Web; frozen role abilities must match role and writable roots.
